title: Fire at Warehouse on Anbar-e Naft Street in Tehran Brought Under Control
text:
Fire at Warehouse on Anbar-e Naft Street in Tehran Brought Under Control"

"🔹 A fire that broke out early this morning at a warehouse on Tehran's Anbar-e Naft Street was brought under control by firefighters."

"🔹 The blaze started at 1:41 AM in a warehouse measuring 300 to 400 square meters, which was used to store detergents and food products."

"🔹 Fortunately, there were no injuries, and the fire did not spread to other buildings.
